methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.5x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
OBSIDIA Semiconductor is a seed-stage chip design company founded by Erik Hosler and Adam Wilson. The valuation universe comprises 3 public semiconductor peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private competitors including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, PsiQuantum, and Etched, yielding a 12-company sector comparison set.

Two standard triangulation methods cannot be applied to this target. Peer-median analysis fails due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow semiconductor space—only 1 adjacent-stage peer exists against a minimum threshold of 3 needed for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring is inapplicable because OBSIDIA's revenue is not disclosed, precluding use of the 21.5x P/S median observed across the three public chip names. The absence of revenue disclosure is typical for private-stage companies and prevents derivation of a defensible valuation range through standard multiples-based methods.

Without applicable triangulation methods and no disclosed financials, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range. The key uncertainties blocking valuation are: undisclosed revenue or revenue run-rate, lack of sufficient private peer data at the seed stage, and absence of meaningful profitability or cash-flow metrics. Any valuation would require either direct access to confidential financials or negotiated price discovery with existing investors.
